name: sectionsight
description: Sets up cookieless, privacy-first website analytics (time per page section, consent banner, PostHog replay only after consent, Slack or e-mail reports, health alerts) and proves the privacy claims with a headless-browser check.

interface.shortDescription: Privacy-first website analytics, proven in a real browser
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to add analytics to a site and sectionsight asks the few owner decisions, builds a cookieless tracker that measures time per page section, a same-origin collector, and optionally a consent banner, PostHog replay only after consent, Slack or e-mail reports and health alerts. It drafts the privacy-page text and then runs a Playwright check: nothing stored before consent, no e-mail or token from the URL in any report, private pages silent. It never claims legal compliance.
defaultPrompt: Add privacy-first analytics to this site
Check that this site stores nothing before consent
Send me a Slack line for every notable visit
